translation_direction: ja → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Japanese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Ichiyō’s long unquoted chains of narration and speech are kept as long Vietnamese sentences joined by commas and semicolons, without quotation marks.
decisions.rationale: The fusion of voices is part of the style; speaker changes remain legible through Vietnamese address forms.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: 關や關や no longer reads as ‘Mr Seki’: ông gọi Seki ơi, Seki à; 二言目には as hở ra là.
She bites her sleeve to hold back the sob (toan òa lên thì cắn chặt tay áo lót mà nén lại).
綿銘仙 is cotton meisen, not padded.
おほゝ as a refined laugh (cười nhỏ nhẹ); けろ〳〵 as tỉnh như không.
威勢よき黒ぬり車 as a gleaming, briskly running carriage; also 毛繻子 as cheap wool-satin (1.3), the father’s scolding (1.3), the dangling clause in 1.3 and the resignation sentence in 1.9.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.source_term: 十三夜 / 十五夜 / 片月見
glossary.draft_rendering: đêm mười ba / đêm rằm tháng tám / ngắm trăng lẻ một đêm thì cũng kiêng
glossary.rationale: The thirteenth-night moon viewing of the ninth lunar month completes the mid-autumn viewing; viewing only one is unlucky.
Seki without the honorific only where the source itself drops お.

glossary.draft_rendering: quan hàm tấu nhiệm / búi tóc marumage
glossary.rationale: Rank and married woman’s hairstyle kept as period markers without in-text glosses.

witness_decision: Selected the Aozora Bunko transcription (card 55670) made from the first publication itself, 文藝倶樂部 閨秀小説號 (博文館, 10 December 1895), in old kanji and kana. Later collected-works texts (Aozora cards 386 and 56040) were not used.

unresolved_questions.explanation: 奏任 and 片月見 are rendered without in-text glosses; readers unfamiliar with Meiji ranks or the two-moon custom may need a note.

title_review.rationale: Đêm mười ba keeps the plain calendar title; the moon is implied as in the Japanese, and the custom is explained in the story itself.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared section 上: arrival, the parents, the dumplings, the request, the marriage, the father’s counsel and the return.
Compared section 下: the rickshaw, Ueno, Rokunosuke’s recognition and story, and the parting.
